content.text: The evidence clearly shows the feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` being ramped on (177/23 at 07:10, then fully "on" at 07:11) coinciding exactly with the ZeroDivisionError onset and error rate spike. The cpu_limit_cores stayed flat at 3.0 throughout, ruling out autoscaling-pathology/demand-saturation as competing explanations.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled on (ramping from off to on between 07:09 and 07:11), immediately exposing a ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py:47 that had not been triggered while the flag was off, causing the account page error rate to spike from ~1% to over 30%.

supporting_evidence.claim: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on
monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations ... account page error rate at 1.50% over the last minute
monthly-spend-feature=off 177 / on 23 - 200 evaluations ... ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 ... account page error rate at 6.00% over the last minute
monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations ... ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 ... account page error rate at 32.00% over the last minute
cpu_limit_cores holds steady at 3.0 across the entire window, including the incident minutes
